content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Insurance underwriter earning premiums and annuity spreads, not an investment manager earning fees on managed assets."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Affiliated boutique investment manager earning fees on assets across funds and separate accounts, like the target."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Primarily a life and annuity insurer funded by premiums; asset management is secondary to its insurance business."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Investment manager running mutual funds, ETFs and separate accounts for advisors and institutions, earning asset-based fees."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Alternative asset manager earning management and performance fees on funds and separate accounts, including real assets."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Primarily research, data, ratings and software sold by subscription; its portfolio management is a minor business."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Operates OTC trading venues and issuer disclosure services, earning listing, data and trading fees rather than managing assets."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Private markets investment manager earning fees on funds, though its significant lending activity differs from the target's public strategies."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Fee-based discretionary investment manager using separate accounts and pooled funds, though focused on high-net-worth individuals."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Sells software licenses and runs outsourced back-office operations for financial firms, not investment management."},{"label":"C11","good":true,"reason":"Affiliated boutique manager earning fees on funds and separate accounts sold through advisers and to institutions, like the target."}]}
